The change in option premium due to time decay
The change in option premium for a change in volatility
The change in option premium for a change in interest rates

explanation.text: The Logic: Delta is defined as the change in option premium per unit change in the underlying price. Call delta is positive (between 0 and +1) and put delta is negative (between 0 and -1). The Trap: Time decay corresponds to Theta, volatility sensitivity to Vega, and interest-rate sensitivity to Rho; do not confuse Delta with these other Greeks. Note: Pages 72-73 of the NISM Series-I workbook support the delta definition and its sign convention for calls and puts used here.
